messages:
maya (producer): First cut + transcript for Argentum Cloud case is uploaded: https://files.redwood/argentum-cut1.mp4. Need legal on hero quote, product to sanity-check technical callouts, and routing for inbound leads. Proposed embargo 2025-10-07 09:00 PT.

marta (prod-marketing): Nice! Keep hero very short (<=12 words). We'll do blog + 30s social + webinar follow-up.

maya (producer): Hero candidate: "Redwood helped Argentum cut inference costs ~3x and stabilize P95 latency." Full quote in transcript.

ben (legal): Quick flags: use "helped" and approximate multiplier (~3x) — finance must sign off for exacts. Remove any raw telemetry screenshots unless we have explicit release. Send benchmark appendix if you want the number cited.

tom (sales-ops): On routing: when live, tag leads utm_campaign=argentum-case and route to queue SDR-Argentum. Sample webhook: ```curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood/lead-route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"{{email}}","source":"case-argentum","queue":"SDR-Argentum"}'```

zara (growth): I can build the landing + UTMs. Suggest webinar 2 weeks post-embargo (2025-10-21 10:00 PT) 1 a 40-min technical session. Could be a good MQL driver.

marta (prod-marketing): Confirm speakers: Argentum infra lead + Redwood Solutions Eng. Maya, can you draft a 1-pager and a short demo checklist for CS?

maya (producer): Confirmed. I'll upload a one-pager and redacted perf CSV by EOD.

ben (legal): I'll approve the hero once the appendix and release form are attached to the sign-off email. If marketing wants the exact 3.0x callout, finance must confirm and we'll cite the dataset.

tom (sales-ops): Also add automation: if lead.role=="infra" then assign to Platform SDRs; if role=="pm" assign to Product SDR. I'll document mapping.

zara (growth): I'll drop two hero variants in #design-requests for A/B testing: (A) short hero, (B) CTA-first hero directing to webinar.

publish-bot: upload complete: argentum-cut1.mp4 (98MB)

marta (prod-marketing): Timeline recap:
- Legal sign-off + appendix: by 2025-09-30
- Final edit + social assets: by 2025-10-03
- Landing + routing in place: by 2025-10-05
- Embargo: 2025-10-07 09:00 PT
- Webinar: 2025-10-21 10:00 PT
Please flag blockers here.

maya (producer): Noted on brand: Argentum asked that we not include competitor names; redacting a single line from transcript now.

ben (legal): Approval email queued pending attachments. I'll send once appendix is attached.

marta (prod-marketing): Keep embargo internal until 10/07: only stakeholders on the approval email can discuss.

maya (producer): Closing 1 assets uploaded, legal looped, landing & webinar planning in flight. Will update with final assets.

marta (prod-marketing): Thanks team. End of thread.
